name: ai-visibility-index-trading-brands
title: AI Visibility Index for Trading Brands
description: A quarterly measurement of what AI assistants tell traders about forex and CFD brokers, prop trading firms and crypto exchanges. Scores from 0 to 100 for every brand the answers name, by market and by source.

fields.name: category
fields.description: forex (forex and CFD brokers), prop (prop trading firms) or crypto (crypto exchanges).

fields.name: geo
fields.description: Market: two-letter country code, a region (EUROPE, LATAM) or all.

fields.name: engine
fields.description: Source: openai, anthropic, gemini, perplexity, google_ai_mode, google_ai_overview, google_organic, or all.

fields.name: visibility
fields.description: AI Visibility Score, 0 to 100: 100 x (0.40 mention_rate + 0.30 rec_rate x position_score + 0.15 sentiment_score + 0.15 own_cite_rate).

fields.name: mention_rate
fields.description: Share of answers to questions that name no brand which name this brand, 0 to 1.

fields.name: rec_rate
fields.description: Share of those answers that recommend the brand, 0 to 1.

fields.name: position_score
fields.description: How high the brand sits when recommended, 0 to 1. First in a list is 1; a recommendation in plain text counts 0.6.

fields.name: sentiment_score
fields.description: Average tone over every answer that names the brand: positive 1.0, neutral 0.6, caution 0.3, negative 0.

fields.name: own_cite_rate
fields.description: Share of answers naming the brand that cite the brand's own website, 0 to 1.

fields.name: share_of_voice
fields.description: Brand mentions divided by all brand mentions in the same category, market and source.

fields.name: n
fields.description: Answers in this cut to questions that name no brand.

fields.name: n_mentions
fields.description: How many of those answers name the brand.

fields.name: ci_low
fields.description: Low end of the score's range (95% Wilson interval on the mention rate), 0 to 100.

fields.name: ci_high
fields.description: High end of the score's range, 0 to 100.
